name: Jarah
title: Descendant of King Saul
summary: Jarah (also called Jehoaddah) was a descendant of King Saul through the line of Jonathan. He is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as the son of Ahaz and the father of Alemet, Asmaveth, and Zimri. He is part of the Benjaminite lineage that continues Saul's family.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Saul's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jarah is listed as the son of Ahaz in the genealogy of King Saul's descendants through Jonathan and Mephibosheth.

keyEvents.title: Jarah's sons are mentioned
keyEvents.description: Jarah's three sons Alemet, Asmaveth and Simri are listed as his descendants in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in an earlier genealogy
keyEvents.description: The same family line is also given in 1 Chronicles chapter 8, where the name Jehoaddah is used as a variant of Jarah.

keyEvents.title: Jehoaddah's sons in parallel text
keyEvents.description: In the parallel genealogy in 1 Chronicles 8, the same sons Alemet, Asmaveth and Simri are mentioned under the name Jehoaddah.
